comment: Registry of projects patuh checks. Baselines pin the state being guarded; drift is reported, never auto-fixed. Entries carrying baseline_source were qualified 2026-11-20 when enforcing family release checks beyond Nada was decided; their per-app permission/license baselines are seeded from the shipped source at that date and detect future drift only - seeding is not approval or security validation, and says so in each entry. The license check was removed 2026-11-24 at the owner's request; license_baseline fields were dropped (they remain in git history).

projects.permissions_note: Rebaselined 2026-11-20 to the actual shipped implementation (kokok e7143def, released as v0.2.1): ACCESS_NETWORK_STATE (normal, install-time) supports the existing network-constrained JobScheduler feed sync required on Android 14; MODIFY_AUDIO_SETTINGS (normal) backs the explicit alarm-volume UI action adjustStreamVolume(STREAM_ALARM, ADJUST_SAME, FLAG_SHOW_UI) - no programmatic volume set; ACTIVITY_RECOGNITION (runtime) powers the optional sleep updates requested 2026-11-20 - off by default, requested only when the user enables it, denial keeps it off, on-device only, no mic/camera/location. No new permission grant is implied; this records what already shipped.
